heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 15150636:2002.Aug. 9, 1982, Pub. L. 97–231, § 2, 96 Stat. 256. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
